displayName: Demo - Require phishing-resistant MFA for privileged roles (report-only)

emergencyAccessExclusion.description: Object ID of the tenant's emergency-access (break-glass) group. Every break-glass account must sit in this group and remain excluded from this policy so a Conditional Access misconfiguration can never lock the tenant out. A future apply workflow must fail closed if this placeholder is still present.

notes: Report-only demo input for a Microsoft Graph conditionalAccessPolicies resource. conditions.users.includeRoles lists Microsoft Entra built-in directory role *template IDs* (GUIDs, documented in identity/schema/known-entra-ids.json) for Global Administrator, Privileged Role Administrator, Security Administrator, Conditional Access Administrator, Application Administrator, and Cloud Application Administrator; Microsoft Graph does not accept role display names or an 'All users' value here. grantControls.authenticationStrength references the built-in 'Phishing-resistant MFA' authenticationStrengthPolicy (id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004) as its own Graph relationship, not as a builtInControls entry. Not applied to any tenant by this repository. Before controlled deployment: (1) replace the emergency-access placeholder with a real, monitored break-glass group object ID, (2) confirm the tenant has an Entra ID P2 (or Microsoft Entra Suite / EMS E5 equivalent) license granting Conditional Access and Authentication Strengths, (3) review sign-in logs for the report-only period before switching state to 'enabled', (4) keep this exclusion group's sign-ins outside all other Conditional Access policies in this folder as well.
